method: Round 1 compares complete bytes of same-name files. Round 2 removes assembly comments and blank lines, strips edge whitespace, retains code spelling and string contents, then covers every code line with exact contiguous matching blocks of at least two lines from same-name references. C/H comments are retained conservatively. Matching blocks may come from different reference versions. Additional round 2 rule: an entire file of at least two code lines appearing as an ordered subsequence of one same-name reference also qualifies, including individual lines separated by reference-only additions.
limitations: This is textual qualification, not proof of historical DOS 5 origin, macro expansion, cross-file behavior, or target binary identity. Conservative matching can leave eligible files pending.
